caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four drawers, each equipped with two oval-shaped, brass-colored handles. The body of the chest is a darker brown, while the front panels of the drawers are a lighter, golden-brown hue, showcasing a visible woodgrain pattern. Each drawer has a small keyhole at the center above the handles. The chest has a slightly curved front and is supported by four turned, spindle-style legs, also in a dark brown color. The sides and top surface of the chest are shaded to suggest dimensionality, and the background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or decorative elements present.
title: Chest of Drawers
